# Read in data
Data was processed in QIIME2 following [Sarah Tucker's 16S pipeline](https://github.com/tucker4/Tucker_Phytoplankton_KByT_HeNERR/blob/main/analysis/Qiime_to_Phyloseq/Tucker_et_al_Qiime_to_Phyloseq.Rmd).

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(funrar)
library(paletteer)
library(stringr)
library(vegan)
library(tidyr)
```

# Data Prep

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setwd("~/Desktop/Genki Ball Sequence Data/")

asvtable <- read.delim("~/Desktop/Genki Ball Sequence Data/qiime2/asvtable_export/genki_asvtable.tsv")
original_tax <- read.delim("~/Desktop/Genki Ball Sequence Data/qiime2/taxonomy_export/taxonomy.tsv")

# break up taxonomy info into separate columns
tax <- original_tax %>%
  tidyr::separate(Taxon, 
           c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
           sep = ";")

# remove prefixes
tax$Kingdom <- substr(tax$Kingdom, 4, nchar(tax$Kingdom))
tax[,3:8] <- apply(tax[,3:8], 2, function(x) substr(x, 5, nchar(x)))

# make more legible ASV names
tax$ASV_name <- paste0("ASV", 1:nrow(tax))

asvtable$ASV_name <- tax$ASV_name[match(tax$Feature.ID, asvtable$X)]

asvtable <- asvtable %>% 
  select(X, ASV_name, everything()) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ASV_name")

asvtable <- asvtable[,2:ncol(asvtable)]

#write.csv(asvtable, "outputs/newsamps/tank_and_field_asv_table_before_cull.csv")

```

## Quality control

Sarah's [PeerJ paper](https://peerj.com/articles/12274/) removed ASVs if they didn't have at least 10 reads across 2 samples. 

8845 ASVs are only present in one sample. The histogram shows ASV read sums.
```{r}
asv_presabs <- asvtable
asv_presabs[asv_presabs>0] <- 1

singletons <- asv_presabs[rowSums(asv_presabs)==1,]
singletons <- singletons[,colSums(singletons)>0]

test <- asvtable[rownames(asvtable)%in%rownames(singletons),]
hist(rowSums(test), breaks=200)

```

Here is the breakdown of how many singleton ASVs had how many reads. 2060 ASVs had 2 reads, 1293 ASVs had 3 reads, and so on.

```{r}
table(rowSums(test))
```

```{r}
ntc <- asvtable[,grepl("NTC", colnames(asvtable))]
ntc <- ntc[rowSums(ntc)>0,]
ntc$taxonomy <- tax$all[match(rownames(ntc), tax$ASV_name)]

tax$all <- paste(tax$Kingdom, tax$Phylum, tax$Class, tax$Order, tax$Family, tax$Genus, tax$Species, sep=";")
```


For now, I did a quality control method from a former postdoc in my former lab, Laura Tipton.

It involves looking for natural "breaks" in the plotted curve of log-transformed read sums per ASV. No clear breaks are seen here, but I went with a cutoff of 3 reads per now (cull any ASV with 3 or fewer reads) in efforts to get rid of potentially spurious things but maintain as much diversity as possible. 

This got rid of 3353 ASVs (22% of the ASVs).

I didn't cull any samples because the lowest read count was 15K.

```{r}

asvsums <- rowSums(asvtable)

summary(asvsums)

# is the maximum an outlier?
tail(sort(asvsums),5)

plot(sort(log1p(asvsums)), pch=19, xlab="Number of otus", ylab="Log of Reads", main="ASVs by read abundance with cutoffs set at 2, 3, and 10 reads")
abline(h=log1p(2), lty=2, col="blue")
abline(h=log1p(3), lty=2, col="green") # I selected this cutoff
abline(h=log1p(10), lty=2, col="magenta")

asv_culled <- asvtable[rowSums(asvtable)>3,] # removes 3353 ASVs
```

Sarah also removed anything undefined at domain and unclassified at phylum.

This gets rid of 9 ASVs undefined at domain (all ASVs that were unclassified at phylum did have a domain assigned).

```{r}
unas_phy <- tax[tax$ASV_name %in% rownames(asv_culled),]
unas_phy <- unas_phy[is.na(unas_phy$Phylum),]

unassigned_kingdom <- tax[tax$ASV_name %in% rownames(asv_culled),]
unassigned_kingdom <- unassigned_kingdom$ASV_name[unassigned_kingdom$Kingdom=="ssigned"]

asv_culled2 <- asv_culled[!rownames(asv_culled) %in% unassigned_kingdom,]

#write.csv(asv_culled2, "tank_asv_table_after_cull.csv")
```

## Apply filters on what's considered EM

The ASV must have more than 10 reads across 2 or more samples.
```{r}
em_asv <- asv_culled2[,grepl("EM",names(asv_culled2))]
em_asv <- em_asv[rowSums(em_asv)>0,]

em_bool <- as.data.frame(em_asv > 0)
em_keep <- rownames(em_bool[rowSums(em_bool)>1,])

em_asv_keep <- em_asv[rownames(em_asv) %in% em_keep,]
#em_asv_keep$tax <- tax$all[match(rownames(em_asv_keep), tax$ASV_name)]

min(rowSums(em_asv_keep)) # minimum row sum was 15

# remove old em samples
asv_culled3 <- asv_culled2[,!grepl("EM", names(asv_culled2))]
asv_culled3 <- as.data.frame(t(asv_culled3))

asv_culled4 <- plyr::rbind.fill(asv_culled3, as.data.frame(t(em_asv_keep)))
rownames(asv_culled4) <- c(rownames(asv_culled3), names(em_asv_keep))
asv_culled4 <- as.data.frame(t(asv_culled4))

sapply(asv_culled4, anyNA) # em samples have NAs

asv_culled4[is.na(asv_culled4)] <- 0 # replace NA with 0
asv_culled4 <- asv_culled4[rowSums(asv_culled4)>0,]

check <- asv_culled4[,grepl("EM",names(asv_culled4))]
check <- check[rowSums(check)>0,]

#write.csv(asv_culled4, "outputs/newsamps/tank_and_field_asv_table_after_cull.csv")
asv_culled4 <- read.csv("outputs/newsamps/tank_and_field_asv_table_after_cull.csv", row.names = 1)

# make relative abundance table
asv_ra <- t(asv_culled4)

asv_ra <- funrar::make_relative(asv_ra)

asv_ra <- as.data.frame(t(asv_ra))
```


**The final ASV table has 11,558 ASVs across 162 samples.**

# What's in a genki ball, by genus (all genki balls)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tax <- read.csv("outputs/newsamps/tank_and_field_taxonomy.csv", row.names=1)

# get genki ball data
gballs_asv <- asv_ra[,grepl("B", names(asv_ra))]
gballs_asv <- gballs_asv[rowSums(gballs_asv)>0,]


gballs <- gballs_asv
# add taxonomy info
gballs$genus <- tax$Genus[match(rownames(gballs), tax$ASV_name)]
gballs$family <- tax$Family[match(rownames(gballs), tax$ASV_name)]
gballs$order <- tax$Order[match(rownames(gballs), tax$ASV_name)]
gballs$class <- tax$Class[match(rownames(gballs), tax$ASV_name)]
gballs$phylum <- tax$Phylum[match(rownames(gballs), tax$ASV_name)]
gballs$kingdom <- tax$Kingdom[match(rownames(gballs), tax$ASV_name)]
gballs$asv <- rownames(gballs)

# transform table to long format
gballs_long <- reshape2::melt(gballs)
names(gballs_long) <- c("Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class", "Phylum", "Kingdom","ASV", "Ball_id", "Relative_Abundance")
gballs_long$genfam <- paste(gballs_long$Family, gballs_long$Genus, sep=";")
gballs_long$alltax <- paste(gballs_long$Kingdom,
                            gballs_long$Phylum,
                            gballs_long$Class,
                            gballs_long$Order,
                            gballs_long$Family,
                            gballs_long$Genus,
                            sep = ";")

gballs_summ_g <- gballs_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Ball_id, Genus, genfam, alltax) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(Relative_Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Ball_id, desc(total))

gballs_summ_g <- gballs_summ_g[gballs_summ_g$total>0,]

gballs_summ_f <- gballs_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Ball_id, Family) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(Relative_Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Ball_id, desc(total))

gballs_summ_f <- gballs_summ_f[gballs_summ_f$total>0,]

# designate top 10 
tenlist <- list()
for (i in 1:length(unique(gballs_summ_g$Ball_id))) {
  x = unique(gballs_summ_g$Ball_id)
  y = gballs_summ_g[gballs_summ_g$Ball_id==x[[i]],]
  tenlist[[x[[i]]]] = y$alltax[1:10]
}
  
names(tenlist) <- unique(gballs_summ_g$Ball_id)
# indicate the top 10 taxa in each gball
gballs_summ_g$top10 <- FALSE
gballs_summ_g$top10[1:10] <- TRUE
gballs_summ_g$top10[131:140] <- TRUE
gballs_summ_g$top10[276:285] <- TRUE

# # put family names to the unassigned genera (use commented out code at bottom of chunk)
top10_dat <- gballs_summ_g
top10_dat$Genus <- ifelse(top10_dat$top10==TRUE, top10_dat$Genus, "Other")
top10_dat$Genus <- ifelse(top10_dat$genfam=="Promicromonosporaceae;NA", "Promicromonosporaceae", top10_dat$Genus)
top10_dat$Genus <- ifelse((grepl("Enterobacteriaceae", top10_dat$genfam) & top10_dat$top10==TRUE), "Enterobacteriaceae", top10_dat$Genus)
#top10_dat$Genus <- ifelse(top10_dat$Genus=="Clostridium_sensu_stricto_1",
#                          "Clostridium", top10_dat$Genus)

# clean up labels
top10_dat$Genus <- factor(top10_dat$Genus, levels = c("Bacillus",
                                                      "Enterobacteriaceae",
                                                      "Streptomyces",
                                                      "Promicromonosporaceae",
                                                      "Isoptericola",
                                                      "Microbacterium",
                                                      "Clostridium_sensu_stricto_1",
                                                      "Cellulosimicrobium",
                                                      "Olivibacter",
                                                      "Promicromonospora",
                                                      "Nocardioides",
                                                      "Pseudoxanthomonas",
                                                      "Other"))

gen_palette <- c("#4059AD", "#003366", "#6B9AC4", "#97D8C4", "#117733", "#999933","#F4B942",
                 "#CC6677", "#882255","#AA4499", "darkorchid4", "#330066", "#DDDDDD")

top10_dat <- top10_dat %>%
  mutate(Ball_id =  case_when(Ball_id == "G46_B1_X" ~ "Ball 1",
                              Ball_id == "G47_B2_X" ~ "Ball 2",
                              Ball_id == "G48_B3_X" ~ "Ball 3"))

toplot <- top10_dat %>% group_by(Ball_id, Genus) %>% summarise(total = sum(total))
toplot <- na.omit(toplot)
toplot <- toplot[toplot$Ball_id %in% c("Ball 1", "Ball 2", "Ball 3"),]

balltax <- ggplot(toplot, aes(x=Ball_id, y=total, fill=Genus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gen_palette) +
  #scale_fill_manual(name = "Genus or Family", 
  #                  values = c(paletteer_d("IslamicArt::samarqand")[1:11], "lightgray")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Genki Ball", y = "Relative Abundance", fill = "Genus or Family") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
```

## EM

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# use the EM ASVs and see what's in the genki balls
em_data <- asv_ra[,grepl("EM", names(asv_ra))]
em_data <- em_data[rowSums(em_data)>0,]

em_asvs <- rownames(em_data)

# add taxonomy info
em_data$genus <- tax$Genus[match(rownames(em_data), tax$ASV_name)]
em_data$family <- tax$Family[match(rownames(em_data), tax$ASV_name)]
em_data$order <- tax$Order[match(rownames(em_data), tax$ASV_name)]
em_data$class <- tax$Class[match(rownames(em_data), tax$ASV_name)]
em_data$phylum <- tax$Phylum[match(rownames(em_data), tax$ASV_name)]
em_data$asv <- rownames(em_data)

# transform table to long format
em_melt <- reshape2::melt(em_data)
names(em_melt) <- c("Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class", "Phylum", "ASV", "EM_id", "Relative_Abundance")
em_melt$general_genus <- ifelse(grepl("Clostridium", em_melt$Genus), "Clostridium", em_melt$Genus)

em_melt$gen_or_fam <- ifelse(is.na(em_melt$general_genus),
                             em_melt$Family,
                             em_melt$general_genus)

em_melt$gen_or_fam <- ifelse(grepl("uncultured|Incertae", em_melt$general_genus), 
                             em_melt$Family,
                             em_melt$gen_or_fam)


em_summ_g <- em_melt %>%
  dplyr::group_by(EM_id, gen_or_fam, Family) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(Relative_Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EM_id, desc(total))

em_taxabar <- ggplot(em_summ_g, aes(x=EM_id, y=total, fill=factor(gen_or_fam, levels = rev(unique(em_summ_g$gen_or_fam))))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Oscillospiraceae"="#DDA0DDFF",
                               "Hungateiclostridiaceae"="#32CD32FF",
                               "Anaerospora"="#FFA07AFF",
                               "Ruminococcaceae"="#F0E68CFF",
                               "Bacillus"="#4682B4FF",
                               "Desulfotomaculum"="#40E0D0FF",
                               "Lachnoclostridium"="#BA55D3FF",
                               "Tissierella"="#D2B48CFF",
                               "Acetobacter"="#87CEEBFF",
                               "Clostridium"="#F2B701FF",
                               "Lactobacillus"="#8FBC8BFF")) +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Relative Abundance", fill = "Genus or Family") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))

em_taxabar

ggsave("figures/newseqs/forum/em_taxabar_clos_collapsed.pdf", em_taxabar, width=6, height=5)

library(patchwork)
twoplot <- em_taxabar + balltax

ggsave("figures/newseqs/figs_apr2026/em_gb_taxonomy.png", twoplot, width=11, height=4.5)
ggsave("figures/newseqs/figs_apr2026/em_gb_taxonomy.pdf", twoplot, width=11, height=4.5)
```

# Tank sediment microbiome over time

```{r, fig.width=20}
setwd("~/Desktop/Genki Ball Sequence Data/")
# read in sediment metadata
sed_metadata <- read.csv("metadata/Tank_Experiment_Sample_list.csv")
sed_metadata$Combined.Name <- str_replace_all(sed_metadata$Combined.Name, "-", "_")
# get sediment + genki ball data
sed <- asv_ra[,names(asv_ra) %in% sed_metadata$Combined.Name]
sed <- sed[rowSums(sed)>0,]

sed$asv <- rownames(sed)

# transform table to long format and add in sample context
sed_long <- reshape2::melt(sed)
sed_long <- sed_long[sed_long$value>0,]

sed_long <- sed_long %>%
  mutate(treatment = case_when(grepl("H", variable) ~ "High",
                              grepl("C", variable) ~ "Control",
                              grepl("L", variable) ~ "Low",
                              grepl("B", variable) ~ "Genki Ball"))
sed_long$timepoint <- str_sub(sed_long$variable, -1)
sed_long$replicate <- paste0("R",str_sub(sed_long$variable, -3, -3))
sed_long$tank <- sed_metadata$Tank[match(sed_long$variable, sed_metadata$Combined.Name)]

sed_long <- sed_long %>% 
  mutate(Ball_id =  case_when(variable == "G46_B1_X" ~ "Ball 1",
                              variable == "G47_B2_X" ~ "Ball 2",
                              variable == "G48_B3_X" ~ "Ball 3"),
         days_since_deploy = case_when(timepoint == 1 ~ "T0",
                                       timepoint == 2 ~ "T7",
                                       timepoint == 3 ~ "T35",
                                       timepoint == 4 ~ "T70",
                                       timepoint == 5 ~ "T100"))

#sed_long$days_since_deploy <- factor(sed_long$days_since_deploy, levels=c(0,7,35,70,100))

# Sampling dates: 

# Day 0: 10/4/23  
# Day 7: 10/11/23  
# Day 35: 11/8/23  
# Day 70: 12/13/23  
# Day 100: 1/12/24 

# split data
sed_only <- sed_long[!grepl("B", sed_long$variable),]
ball_only <- sed_long[grepl("B", sed_long$variable),]
before_deployment_only <- sed_long[(sed_long$timepoint==1),]
control_only <- sed_long[sed_long$treatment=="Control",]

sed_asv <- unique(sed_only$asv)
ball_asv <- unique(ball_only$asv)
before_deploy_asv <- unique(before_deployment_only$asv)
control_asv <- unique(control_only$asv)

em_asvs <- rownames(em_asv_keep)

# shared asvs - things in the genki ball that were also in the sediment before ball deployment
overlap <- unique(c(before_deploy_asv, control_asv))
shared_asv <- intersect(ball_asv, overlap)

# designate 4 community compartments: EM, genki ball, shared, Hamakua
sed_long$category <- "Hamakua Microbiome"
sed_long$category <- ifelse(sed_long$asv %in% ball_asv, "Genki Ball Background Microbiome", sed_long$category)
sed_long$category <- ifelse(sed_long$asv %in% em_asvs, "EM Microbiome", sed_long$category) 
sed_long$category <- ifelse(sed_long$asv %in% shared_asv, "Hamakua - Genki Ball Shared Microbiome", sed_long$category) 

sed_long$category <- factor(sed_long$category, levels=c("EM Microbiome",
                                                            "Genki Ball Background Microbiome",
                                                            "Hamakua Microbiome",
                                                            "Hamakua - Genki Ball Shared Microbiome"))

sed_data <- sed_long[!grepl("B", sed_long$variable),]
sed_data$treatment = factor(sed_data$treatment, levels = c("Control", "Low", "High"))

gb_data <- sed_long[grepl("B", sed_long$variable),]
gb_data$days_since_deploy = ""
gb_data$treatment = "Genki Ball"

sedgb <- plyr::rbind.fill(sed_data, gb_data)
sedgb$treatment = factor(sedgb$treatment, levels = c("Genki Ball", "Control", "Low", "High"))

sedgb$days_since_deploy = factor(sedgb$days_since_deploy, levels = c("T0", "T7", "T35", "T70", "T100"))

sedgb_summ <- sedgb %>% group_by(treatment, replicate, category, days_since_deploy) %>% summarise(value = sum(value))

sediment_colors <- c(
  "EM Microbiome" = "#6B9AC4",
  "Genki Ball Background Microbiome" = "#4059AD",
  "Hamakua Microbiome" = "#97D8C4",
  "Hamakua - Genki Ball Shared Microbiome" = "#F4B942")

sedpl <- ggplot(sedgb_summ, aes(x = replicate, y = value, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sediment_colors) + # Apply the updated color palette
  facet_nested(~ treatment + days_since_deploy, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Sediment Sample Replicates", y = "Relative Abundance", fill = "ASV") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16),
        #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size=16)) 

sedpl
```

```{r, fig.width=16}
water_metadata <- read.csv("metadata/Tank_Water_Metadata.csv")
water_metadata$Sample.ID <- str_replace(water_metadata$Sample.ID, "_", ".")
water_metadata$Sample.ID <- str_replace(water_metadata$Sample.ID, "L8.110823", "L8.1100823")

# get water data
water <- asv_ra[,names(asv_ra) %in% water_metadata$Sample.ID]
water <- water[rowSums(water)>0,]

water$asv <- rownames(water)

# transform table to long format and add in sample context
water_long <- reshape2::melt(water)
water_long <- water_long[water_long$value>0,]

water_long$treatment <- water_metadata$Treatment.Group[match(water_long$variable, water_metadata$Sample.ID)]

water_long$replicate <- water_metadata$Replicate[match(water_long$variable, water_metadata$Sample.ID)]

water_long$old_days <- water_metadata$Days.Since.Deployment[match(water_long$variable, water_metadata$Sample.ID)]

water_long$tank <- water_metadata$Tank[match(water_long$variable, water_metadata$Sample.ID)]

water_long <- water_long %>% 
  mutate(days_since_deploy = case_when(old_days == 0 ~ "T0",
                                       old_days == 3 ~ "T7",
                                       old_days == 31 ~ "T35",
                                       old_days == 61 ~ "T70",
                                       old_days == 96 ~ "T100"))

# designate 4 community compartments: EM, genki ball, Hamakua, shared
```

# Taxonomy Bubble Plots for EM and GB
Taxa as rows, samples as columns. Size indicates relative abundance
```{r}

emgb_asvs <- c("ASV142", "ASV179", "ASV232", "ASV352", "ASV665")
em_for_bub <- asv_ra[,grepl("EM", names(asv_ra))]
em_for_bub <- em_for_bub[rowSums(em_for_bub)>0,]

gb_for_bub <- asv_ra[,grepl("_B", names(asv_ra))]
gb_for_bub <- gb_for_bub[rowSums(gb_for_bub)>0,]

#gb_for_bub <- gb_for_bub[!(rownames(gb_for_bub) %in% "ASV451"),]

gb_bub_02 <- gb_for_bub[rowSums(gb_for_bub)>0.02,]
gb_bub_02 <- gb_bub_02[!(rownames(gb_bub_02) %in% "ASV451"),]
gb_bub_02 <- rbind(gb_bub_02, gb_for_bub[rownames(gb_for_bub) %in% emgb_asvs,])

gb_and_em <- merge(em_for_bub, gb_bub_02, by = "row.names", all = TRUE)
gb_and_em[is.na(gb_and_em)] <- 0

names(gb_and_em)[c(1,5:7)] <- c("ASV", "Ball 1", "Ball 2", "Ball 3")

gbem_long <- reshape2::melt(gb_and_em)
gbem_long$category <- ifelse(grepl("EM", gbem_long$variable), "EM", "Genki Ball")
gbem_long$ordering <- ifelse(gbem_long$category=="EM", 1, 2)
gbem_long <- gbem_long[gbem_long$value>0,]
gbem_long$ASV <- as.character(gbem_long$ASV)

library(forcats)
gbem_long$ASV <- fct_reorder(gbem_long$ASV, gbem_long$ordering)
gbem_long$Genus <- tax$Genus[match(gbem_long$ASV, tax$ASV_name)]
gbem_long$Species <- tax$Species[match(gbem_long$ASV, tax$ASV_name)]
gbem_long$Family <- tax$Family[match(gbem_long$ASV, tax$ASV_name)]
gbem_long$Class <- tax$Class[match(gbem_long$ASV, tax$ASV_name)]

gbem_long$Species <- gsub("_", " ", gbem_long$Species)
gbem_long$tax_label <- ifelse(is.na(gbem_long$Species),
                              gbem_long$Genus,
                              gbem_long$Species)

gbem_long$fam_gen <- paste(gbem_long$Family, gbem_long$Genus, sep=";")
gbem_long$test <- paste(gbem_long$Family, gbem_long$tax_label, sep=";")

library(tidytext)


# Create ordering that groups by category (EM vs GB) and keeps overlapping ASVs in middle
gbem_long$both <- FALSE
gbem_long$both[gbem_long$ASV %in% c(c("ASV45", "ASV61", "ASV142", "ASV179", "ASV232", "ASV352", "ASV665"))] <- TRUE

gbem_long <- gbem_long %>%
  group_by(category, Family) %>%
  mutate(family_order = max(value)) %>%
  ungroup() 

gbem_long$order <- ifelse(gbem_long$both==TRUE, 2, ifelse(gbem_long$category=="EM", 3, 1))

gbem_long <- gbem_long %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  arrange(order, desc(family_order), Family, value, .by_group = TRUE)



gbem_long <- gbem_long %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  mutate(ASV_ordered = factor(ASV, levels = unique(ASV)))
  
  # Create ordering: EM-only, then both, then GB-only
  # arrange(
  #   ifelse(both, 2, ifelse(gbem_long$category=="EM", 1, 3)),  # Both in middle (2), EM top (1), GB bottom (3)
  #   desc(family_order),
  #   Family,
  #   value
  # ) %>%
  # mutate(ASV_ordered = factor(ASV, levels = unique(ASV)))




gbem_summ <- data.frame(asv = levels(gbem_long$ASV_ordered))
gbem_summ$label <- gbem_long$tax_label[match(gbem_summ$asv, gbem_long$ASV_ordered)]


#gbem_summ <- gbem_long %>% group_by(ASV, Family) %>% summarise(label = unique(tax_label))

# palette
family_colors <- c(
  # set 1
 "#377EB8", "#984EA3", "#A65628", "#F781BF", 

#set 2
"#66C2A5" ,"#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB" ,"#E78AC3" ,"#A6D854", "#FFD92F", "#E5C494", "#B3B3B3",

#set 3
"#8DD3C7", "#BEBADA", "#FB8072", "#80B1D3", "#FDB462", "#B3DE69", "#FCCDE5", "#BC80BD", "#CCEBC5"
)

# Create the plot
```

## Bubbles over time
```{r}
in_em <- rownames(em_asv_keep)
in_gb <- ball_asv

intersect(in_em, in_gb)

in_water <- unique(water_long$asv)
in_sediment <- unique(sed_long$asv)

# take the 30 most relatively abundant ASVs - they are already in numerical order by decreasing RA
asv_for_bub <- asv_ra[rownames(asv_ra) %in% in_em,]
asv_for_bub <- asv_for_bub[,colSums(asv_for_bub)>0]

sed_bub <- sed_long[sed_long$asv %in% in_em,]
sed_bub <- sed_bub %>% group_by(asv, treatment, days_since_deploy) %>% summarise(tot = mean(value))
sed_bub$new_category <- "Sediment"

water_bub <- water_long[water_long$asv %in% in_em,]
water_bub <- water_bub %>% group_by(asv, treatment, days_since_deploy) %>% summarise(tot = mean(value))
water_bub$new_category <- "Water"

em_bub <- em_for_bub[rownames(em_for_bub) %in% in_em,]
em_bub$asv <- rownames(em_bub)
em_bub <- reshape2::melt(em_bub)
em_bub <- em_bub %>% group_by(asv) %>% summarise(tot = mean(value))

em_bub$days_since_deploy <- "T0"
em_bub$treatment <- "EM"
em_bub <- em_bub[,c(1,4,3,2)]
em_bub$new_category <- "EM"
names(em_bub) <- names(water_bub)

all_bub <- plyr::rbind.fill(sed_bub, water_bub)


all_bub <- plyr::rbind.fill(all_bub, em_bub)
all_bub$days_since_deploy[all_bub$treatment=="Genki Ball"] <- "T0"
all_bub$new_category[all_bub$treatment=="Genki Ball"] <- "Genki Ball"


#all_bub$days_since_deploy[all_bub$new_category=="EM"] <- "0"

all_bub$days_since_deploy = factor(all_bub$days_since_deploy, levels = c("T100", "T70", "T35", "T7", "T0"))

#remove control
all_bub <- all_bub[all_bub$treatment!="Control",]

all_bub <- dplyr::arrange(all_bub, new_category, desc(tot))

first_set <- c("ASV45", "ASV61", "ASV179", "ASV665", "ASV142", "ASV232", "ASV352")
second_set <- setdiff(unique(all_bub$asv), first_set)

all_bub$asv <- factor(all_bub$asv,
                      levels = c(first_set, second_set))

bubble_colors <- c(
  "EM" = "#6B9AC4",
  "Genki Ball" = "#4059AD",
  "High" = "#2D7660",
  "Low" = "#97D8C4")

all_bub$treatment <- factor(all_bub$treatment, levels=c("EM", "Genki Ball", "Low", "High"))

# Create the plot
time_bub <- ggplot(all_bub, aes(x = asv, 
                                    y = days_since_deploy, 
                                    size = tot,
                                    color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  #theme_bw() +
  scale_size_continuous(limits = c(0.000001, 100), 
                       range = c(1,150), 
                       breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "ASV", y = "Timepoint", size = "Relative Abundance", color = "Treatment") +
  scale_color_manual(values = bubble_colors) +
   facet_wrap(~ new_category, nrow = 4, strip.position = "left", scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    theme(panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"), 
         strip.background = element_blank(),
         strip.placement = "outside",
         axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
         panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", color=NA),
         panel.grid.major = element_line(color="gray90"),) 
  

ggsave("figures/newseqs/figs_apr2026/bubbles_over_time.pdf", time_bub, width=12, height=5.6)
```

```{r, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
em_tax <- tax[tax$ASV_name %in% em_asvs,]
gb_tax <- tax[tax$ASV_name %in% ball_asv,]

em_and_gb <- intersect(em_tax$ASV_name, gb_tax$ASV_name)

gb_o <- setdiff(gb_tax$ASV_name, em_tax$ASV_name)

taxy <- tax

taxy$em_or_gb[taxy$ASV_name %in% em_and_gb] = "EM and Genki Ball"
taxy$em_or_gb[taxy$ASV_name %in% em_o] = "EM Only"
taxy$em_or_gb[taxy$ASV_name %in% gb_o] = "Genki Ball Only"

taxy <- taxy[taxy$em_or_gb!="placeholder",]

write.csv(em_tax, "outputs/em_asv_taxonomy.csv")
```

# NMDS 

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=8.5}
# sediment, water, EM, and genki balls
for_nmds <- asv_ra
for_nmds <- subset(for_nmds, select=-c(NTC1, NTC2, NTC3, NTC4, PCRpos, G45, G27)) # remove negatives, positive, and resequenced samples
for_nmds <- select(for_nmds, -contains("HMP")) # remove marsh samples
for_nmds <- select(for_nmds, -contains("GBC")) # remove additional genki balls
for_nmds <- as.data.frame(t(for_nmds))
for_nmds$sample_id <- rownames(for_nmds)
  
em_data$asv <- rownames(em_data)
em_long <- reshape2::melt(em_data)
em_long$treatment <- "EM"
all_long <- plyr::rbind.fill(sed_long, water_long)
all_long <- plyr::rbind.fill(all_long, em_long)

for_nmds$treatment <- all_long$treatment[match(for_nmds$sample_id, all_long$variable)]
for_nmds$days_since_deploy <- all_long$days_since_deploy[match(for_nmds$sample_id, all_long$variable)]
for_nmds$tank <- all_long$tank[match(for_nmds$sample_id, all_long$variable)]

matrix_nmds <- as.matrix(for_nmds[,1:(ncol(for_nmds)-4)]) # remove metadata columns


# justification for weakties = FALSE: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/53981811/why-does-metamds-produce-a-horizontal-distribution-of-our-data
all_nmds <- metaMDS(matrix_nmds, distance = "bray")
all_nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(all_nmds)$sites)

all_nmds_scores$treatment = for_nmds$treatment[match(for_nmds$sample_id, rownames(all_nmds_scores))]
all_nmds_scores$timepoint = for_nmds$timepoint[match(for_nmds$sample_id, rownames(all_nmds_scores))]
all_nmds_scores$tank = for_nmds$tank[match(for_nmds$sample_id, rownames(all_nmds_scores))]
all_nmds_scores$tank <- factor(all_nmds_scores$tank, levels=1:9)
all_nmds_scores$days_since_deployment = for_nmds$days_since_deploy[match(for_nmds$sample_id, rownames(all_nmds_scores))]
all_nmds_scores$days_since_deployment <- as.character(all_nmds_scores$days_since_deployment)
all_nmds_scores$days_since_deployment <- factor(all_nmds_scores$days_since_deployment,
                                                levels = c("T0","T7","T35","T70","T100"))

all_nmds_scores$compartment = ifelse(grepl("G", rownames(all_nmds_scores)), "Sediment", "Water")
all_nmds_scores$compartment = ifelse(grepl("B", rownames(all_nmds_scores)), "Genki Ball", all_nmds_scores$compartment)
all_nmds_scores$compartment = ifelse(grepl("EM", rownames(all_nmds_scores)), "EM", all_nmds_scores$compartment)

gen_palette <- c("#4059AD", "#DDDDDD", "#6B9AC4", "#97D8C4", "#117733", "#999933","#F4B942",
                 "#CC6677", "#882255","#AA4499", "darkorchid4")

#library(ggrepel)
library(ggforce)
all_nmds_plot <- ggplot(all_nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2,
                                             shape = treatment, 
                                             #color = tank,
                                             fill = days_since_deployment,
                                             color = compartment))+
                                             #size = compartment)) +
    geom_point(size = 4)+
  #scale_color_manual(values=c("#F4B942", "#AA4499", "#4059AD")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23,24,25)) +
  #stat_ellipse(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = treatment), alpha=0.2) +
  ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, group=compartment, color=compartment)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  geom_text(data=all_nmds_scores,aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2,label=tank),size=4, color="black",vjust=1,hjust=-1) +
  #scale_size_manual(values = c(4, 2)) +
    # geom_label_repel(aes(label = tank),
    #               box.padding   = 0.35,
    #               point.padding = 0.5,
    #               segment.color = 'grey50',
    #               max.overlaps = 70) +
    #stat_ellipse(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, group = compartment), level = 0.50, size=1) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20),

    legend.box = "vertical",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, vjust=3),

     guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape=21))) +

         color = "Compartment") +

all_nmds_plot

ggsave("figures/newseqs/figs_apr2026/nmds_with_ellipses.png", all_nmds_plot, height = 8, width = 8.5)


# permanova
# remove em and gb for this analysis
perm_matrix <- matrix_nmds[!grepl("EM|B", rownames(matrix_nmds)),]
perm_scores <- all_nmds_scores[!grepl("EM|B", rownames(all_nmds_scores)),]

perm_by_treat_and_time <- adonis2(perm_matrix ~ perm_scores$treatment*perm_scores$days_since_deployment, permutations = 9999, method = "bray")

# beta dispersion
bc_mat <- vegdist(perm_matrix)

treat_bd <- betadisper(bc_mat, perm_scores$treatment)
anova(treat_bd)
time_bd <- betadisper(bc_mat, perm_scores$days_since_deployment)
anova(time_bd)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# samples as rows, asvs as columns
sed_for_nmds <- sed[,grepl("G", names(sed))]
sed_for_nmds <- as.data.frame(t(sed_for_nmds))
sed_for_nmds$sample_id <- rownames(sed_for_nmds)

sed_for_nmds <- sed_for_nmds %>%
  mutate(treatment = case_when(grepl("H", sample_id) ~ "High",
                              grepl("C", sample_id) ~ "Control",
                              grepl("L", sample_id) ~ "Low",
                              grepl("B", sample_id) ~ "Genki Ball",))
sed_for_nmds$timepoint <- str_sub(sed_for_nmds$sample_id, -1)

nmds_sed_matrix <- as.matrix(sed_for_nmds[,1:7682])

nmds_sediment <- metaMDS(nmds_sed_matrix, distance = "bray")
nmds_sed_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_sediment)$sites)

nmds_sed_scores$treatment = sed_for_nmds$treatment[match(sed_for_nmds$sample_id, rownames(nmds_sed_scores))]
nmds_sed_scores$timepoint = sed_for_nmds$timepoint[match(sed_for_nmds$sample_id, rownames(nmds_sed_scores))]

sediment_nmds_plot <- ggplot(nmds_sed_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
    geom_point(data = nmds_sed_scores, size = 4, aes(shape = treatment, colour = timepoint))+

    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20),
```
